classes.name: AldunisCodeCli
classes.description: The local Aldunis Code executable boundary that parses structured host and remote-auth commands before startup while preserving loopback defaults and legacy flag compatibility.

classes.name: AldunisLocalHost
classes.description: The local Aldunis Code HTTP host that composes repository, provider, approval, persistence, automation, projection, and presentation modules while preserving loopback and authenticated managed-mode authority.

classes.name: LocalApiDispatchModule
classes.description: An internal deep module that hides local host route selection, authorization-sensitive request handling, dependency coordination, response normalization, and failure mapping behind one request-dispatch interface.

classes.name: BrowserRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates shared-browser route recognition, desktop and managed-mode admission, conversation-to-worktree binding, provider authorization, session lifecycle validation, and broker invocation behind one internal dispatch interface.

classes.name: ProviderRunExecutionModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates LocalConversation run admission, accepted run identity, canonical workspace binding, context assembly, provider selection, persistence, checkpointing, normalized event streaming, recovery, and terminal status behind one typed interface shared by HTTP, automation, and delegated follow-up adapters while provider-specific behavior remains in adapters.

classes.name: ProviderControlRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates provider capabilities, Codex skills, approval projection, run admission dispatch, permission requests, and ordered multi-adapter cancellation behind one internal route interface while provider-specific protocols, permission authority, and run execution remain in their existing adapters and modules.

classes.name: HostCommand
classes.description: A typed Aldunis Code CLI startup command for starting or explicitly serving the local host with validated bind, remote, and TLS options.

classes.name: RemoteAuthCommand
classes.description: A nested Aldunis Code CLI command for creating, listing, or revoking authenticated remote pairing state without starting the host.

classes.name: RemoteAccessRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates remote administration, device pairing, and descriptor route recognition, local-control and managed-host admission, configured-origin readiness, pairing-link derivation, request validation, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface while RemoteAuth retains credential, proof, session, and persistence authority.

classes.name: DesktopRemoteEnvironmentManager
classes.description: The Electron main-process boundary that stores named remote-environment metadata, launches the fixed SSH server and local-forward processes, approves remote origins, and returns the renderer to the local loopback host without storing private keys, provider credentials, or pairing credentials.

classes.name: RemoteEnvironment
classes.description: A local desktop metadata record for one named HTTPS or SSH Aldunis Code workbench environment. It stores only the origin or SSH target, remote backend port, fixed executable name, preferred local forwarding port, and pairing-state hint; it is not repository, provider, or execution authority.

classes.name: SshRemoteWorkbenchTransport
classes.description: The desktop-managed transport that runs an explicit loopback-bound Aldunis Code SSH remote mode and forwards an allocated client loopback port to the remote backend while retaining proof-key application authentication.

classes.name: ConversationComposer
classes.description: The desktop conversation input surface that accepts typed or transient browser speech transcript text while selecting a provider, model, interaction mode, and explicit tool scope.

classes.name: ComposerPopoverInteractionModule
classes.description: A deep renderer module that concentrates mutually-exclusive composer popover lifetime, opening-gesture isolation, outside-pointer suppression, keyboard traversal and activation, disabled-option filtering, and document-listener cleanup behind one hook interface while ConversationComposer retains option rendering and domain selection authority.

classes.name: TranscriptViewportLifecycleModule
classes.description: A deep renderer module that concentrates transcript opening placement, remembered scroll position, follow state, content-growth and resize response, jump-to-latest settling, conversation rebinding, persistence, and browser-resource cleanup behind one hook interface while ConversationComposer retains transcript rendering and content identity.

classes.name: WorkspacePanelLifecycleModule
classes.description: A deep renderer module that concentrates Files, Preview, and Changes panel transitions, roving focus, preview mounting and floating, browser-observation projection, current-versus-immutable-turn review, and reset decisions behind one deterministic interface while ConversationComposer retains DOM, rendering, network refresh, and host preview-process authority.

classes.name: PromptStash
classes.description: A conversation-composer module that atomically loads, parks, restores or swaps, and removes bounded text-only drafts while hiding storage selection, identity isolation, migration, validation, capacity, and persistence failure handling behind one interface.

classes.name: BrowserSpeechRecognition
classes.description: A deep browser-owned optional speech-recognition module that hides recognition lifetime, stale-callback isolation, transcript assembly, pane reset, disposal, and normalized failures behind one ConversationComposer interface; microphone audio is not sent to or persisted by the Aldunis host.

classes.name: ConversationLifecycleControl
classes.description: A deep renderer control module for renaming, pinning, archiving, restoring, settling, releasing, and deleting conversations that concentrates host requests, refresh ordering, deletion pane repair, retry semantics, and bounded partial bulk-release evidence while Workbench retains dialog targets, presentation, and DOM focus and the host retains lifecycle and worktree authority.

classes.name: CollapsibleCodeSidebar
classes.description: The shared Aldunis Code web-renderer sidebar presentation used by browser and Electron desktop clients; it can remove its layout gap while preserving the main conversation surface and a fixed Mod+B keybinding to toggle it. Its compact header mark crops the supplied tile frame, and its macOS collapse/expand control lives in the native row while opting out of the drag region. On macOS Electron, the shell reserves a distinct 52px native-titlebar row above the ordinary app header, with a compact sidebar affordance and aligned sidebar boundary, while keeping the explicitly positioned hidden-inset controls and without changing repository, provider, or permission authority.

classes.name: SidebarLifecycleModule
classes.description: A deep renderer module that concentrates collapsible sidebar open and responsive states, independent desktop and mobile persistence decisions, user/navigation/dialog transition intent, shortcut capture admission, and focus outcomes behind one deterministic interface while Workbench retains browser listeners, storage I/O, rendering, inert projection, and DOM focus execution.

classes.name: SidebarOpenPreference
classes.description: A local browser or desktop-profile presentation preference recording whether the Aldunis Code sidebar should start expanded; it grants no repository, provider, permission, or contract authority.

classes.name: SidebarToggleKeybinding
classes.description: The fixed Mod+B presentation keybinding that toggles the Aldunis Code sidebar without changing conversation, repository, provider, permission, or contract state.

classes.name: ConversationAutomation
classes.description: A durable timer-only Aldunis Code schedule that sends bounded prompts into one existing conversation while preserving the conversation, worktree, provider, and explicit approval boundaries.

classes.name: ConversationAutomationFire
classes.description: A metadata-only durable identity for one scheduled or explicitly requested conversation automation attempt; it records idempotency, bound turn and provider-run identities, bounded outcome, and explicit unknown-after-restart state without raw provider output.

classes.name: AutonomyRun
classes.description: A durable local autonomy execution record with a typed workflow identity, bounded budget, resumable status, trigger provenance, and metadata-only result. It cannot grant provider, filesystem, or approval authority.

classes.name: AutonomyTask
classes.description: One durable bounded step in an AutonomyRun, with retry count, timeout state, approval-gate state, and metadata-only output.

classes.name: AutonomyFlow
classes.description: A typed multi-step local workflow definition with ordered steps, retries, timeouts, explicit approval-gate markers, resumability metadata, and cost/runtime limits. The shipped flows are read-only.

classes.name: HeartbeatMonitor
classes.description: A durable periodic-awareness or scheduled-gardener configuration evaluated while the local Aldunis Code host is alive, with a bounded built-in flow, active hours, and a link to its latest AutonomyRun.

classes.name: StandingOrder
classes.description: A durable operator-authored bounded preference for autonomy planning. It is informational policy input and never expands provider, filesystem, credential, tenant, or approval authority.

classes.name: AutonomyHook
classes.description: An internal event-driven reaction from a local lifecycle event to a built-in read-only AutonomyFlow, guarded by enablement and cooldown metadata.

classes.name: MaintenanceFinding
classes.description: A bounded metadata-only suggestion produced by the nightly maintenance gardener, containing category, severity, optional repository-relative path, risk, and a suggested approved follow-up.

classes.name: MaintenanceGardener
classes.description: The built-in read-only AutonomyFlow that checks repository availability, scans bounded maintenance signals, ranks findings, and produces an operator report without changing source or launching a provider turn.

classes.name: ProviderDiscovery
classes.description: The Aldunis Code host-owned deep module that projects locally available provider adapters, authentication state, versions, models, and profile-specific Shikigami discovery through one authorized-worktree interface; managed mode exposes only its fixed Shikigami model.

classes.name: ProviderRunReadiness
classes.description: The pure Aldunis Code UI eligibility module that interprets provider discovery, selected profiles, and managed constraints through one checking, blocked, or ready interface while leaving launch and model authorization to the host.

classes.name: ProviderProfileDiscovery
classes.description: A profile-keyed provider readiness projection that keeps executable, configuration, authentication, and model discovery aligned with the selected Shikigami profile.

classes.name: ProviderProfileRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates provider discovery and ProviderProfile route recognition, host-mode admission, request and environment validation, adapter-profile seeding, canonical worktree selection, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing provider, filesystem, credential, persistence, or managed-host authority.

classes.name: ShikigamiCheckpointResumeBoundary
classes.description: The Shikigami provider boundary that accepts a provider-confirmed run UUID, loads the matching checkpoint, and requires the canonical workspace and adapter identity to match before native resume.

properties.name: minimum_version
properties.description: The minimum compatible Shikigami version for native parked-run resume.

classes.name: ShikigamiParkedRunResume
classes.description: The Aldunis Code operation that resumes one Shikigami parked run through a bound input request and existing local turn. It keeps the answer transient, requires a fresh PermissionBroker scope, preserves the baseline checkpoint, and reports explicit unavailability when exact identity or capability cannot be proven.

classes.name: ThreadSearch
classes.description: The bounded local conversation metadata search surface that presents selectable thread results without searching messages, provider output, or repository contents.

classes.name: ConversationActivityInbox
classes.description: A derived, read-only cross-project Code workbench projection that groups bounded conversation metadata by operator attention, running, completed, and idle state, serializes event-driven projection refreshes with one coalesced follow-up, and offers explicit open or changes-review navigation without provider, approval, execution, or remote mutation authority.

classes.name: WorkGraph
classes.description: A beta-gated, derived, read-only Aldunis Code conversation view that separates provider-reported plan intent from normalized Aldunis-observed activity for one recent turn; it does not infer hidden provider reasoning, become durable source-of-truth state, or grant execution, approval, filesystem, or provider authority.

classes.name: LocalConversation
classes.description: A provider-independent conversation owned and persisted by Aldunis Code.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: The provider adapter bound to the conversation.

properties.name: worktree
properties.description: The canonical local worktree bound to the conversation.

classes.name: ConversationRunModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates one local conversation run's normalized provider-event transitions, context usage, session identity, approval and input resolution, cancellation, failure, completion, and stale-run isolation behind one reducer interface without acquiring provider-process, persistence, filesystem, or permission authority.

classes.name: ComposerImageStagingModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates bounded composer image validation, in-worktree path reuse, uploaded payload construction, sequential host staging, pin capacity, batch limits, deduplication, partial success, and failure normalization behind one interface without acquiring filesystem, conversation, provider, or permission authority.

classes.name: WorkbenchProjectionSynchronizationModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates local workbench projection refresh coalescing, stale-response suppression, event-stream lifetime, malformed-event rejection, optimistic visit reconciliation, and recovery-field normalization behind one refresh and snapshot interface without acquiring persistence, provider, filesystem, permission, or remote-product authority.

classes.name: SplitWorkspaceLifecycleModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates dual-pane restoration, invariant-preserving pane transitions, project membership and activation decisions, same-project secondary selection, safe conversation repository projection, focus fallback, and resize clamping behind one deterministic interface while CodeWorkbench retains browser, DOM, network, and rendering adapters.

classes.name: LocalApplicationHost
classes.description: The Aldunis Code composition module that constructs the loopback, remote, managed, or desktop HTTP host through one named options interface while keeping stores, provider adapters, permission brokers, schedulers, and request routing inside its implementation.

classes.name: LocalUsageReceipt
classes.description: A bounded, provider-reported numeric observation for one Aldunis Code turn. It contains token and optional cost fields only, supports the local Usage view, excludes prompts, tool payloads, repository content, and credentials, and is not billing truth or Chisei usage authority.

classes.name: TurnChangeSummary
classes.description: A persisted metadata-only summary of one completed Aldunis Code turn's checkpoint diff, including changed paths, states, rename sources, and line counts; it exposes no source content and grants no mutation or delivery authority.

classes.name: ConstrainedWebPreview
classes.description: A loopback-only Aldunis Code preview session that starts one selected worktree's declared development command after scoped approval and renders it in a sandboxed iframe with browser permissions denied.

classes.name: PreviewHostContractModule
classes.description: A scope-bound renderer module that hides constrained-preview and shared-browser routes, request payloads, host-issued identifiers, response validation, transition ordering, and cleanup semantics behind one command interface and idempotent disposal.

classes.name: ConstrainedPreviewRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates constrained-preview lifecycle route recognition, scoped request validation, canonical worktree selection, transition ordering, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface while PreviewManager retains approval and process authority.

classes.name: FloatingWebPreview
classes.description: A transient presentation of a running ConstrainedWebPreview in a fixed in-workbench window so the operator can keep the local application visible while continuing the conversation; it adds no provider-browser, navigation, credential, or persistence authority.

classes.name: EphemeralBrowserObservation
classes.description: A bounded JPEG, PNG, or WebP frame supplied inline by a reviewed provider adapter for read-only operator observation; it is stream-only, never reads a provider filesystem path, and is not persisted as conversation or activity state.

classes.name: SharedBrowserSession
classes.description: A desktop-only Aldunis-owned Electron browser session bound to one local conversation and loopback preview origin, using a conversation-scoped persistent partition and transient page state shared by the operator and an authorized provider.

classes.name: BrowserAutomationBroker
classes.description: A host-owned broker that exposes bounded shared-browser MCP operations, authenticates one conversation-scoped provider token, and rejects actions when agent control is disabled or human input has advanced the control epoch.

classes.name: PictureInPictureBrowserMirror
classes.description: A transient always-on-top desktop mirror of a SharedBrowserSession captured from the same Electron page; it adds presentation only and no independent navigation or control authority.

classes.name: ProviderModelValidationBoundary
classes.description: The Aldunis Code server boundary that resolves requested provider models against current provider capability before state, checkpoint, fork, automation, continuation, or process launch; it persists the effective model and fails closed on stale or unverifiable selections.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationRelationship
classes.description: A local, metadata-only association from one parent conversation to one independently created child conversation. Each child has at most one parent and the relationship set forms an acyclic forest. It never transfers messages, provider context, tool state, or approvals.

classes.name: RendererWorktreeLifecycle
classes.description: The Aldunis Code renderer module that hides worktree creation and removal preview routes, single-use approval requests, repository refresh, server-error extraction, and response validation behind one interface used by worktree management, conversation workspace, and delegated child flows. It grants no filesystem or approval authority beyond the host contracts it invokes.

classes.name: ManagedWorktreeRemovalApproval
classes.description: A short-lived, single-use approval bound to the exact managed checkout inspected during preview. Branch, HEAD, Git administrative directory, filesystem identity, and nanosecond change times must still match before removal.

classes.name: ManagedHostedWorkbench
classes.description: The explicit single-tenant Aldunis Code hosted mode that starts only with trusted gateway assertion configuration, a canonical repository catalogue, and a fixed fail-closed Shikigami Build profile; it never falls back to loopback or paired remote authority.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The immutable managed host mode selected at startup.

properties.name: recovery_policy
properties.description: Dedicated-volume restart preservation with visible loss and no implicit backup.

classes.name: ManagedHostedAssertion
classes.description: A short-lived EdDSA gateway assertion bound to the configured issuer, audience, tenant, instance, Code workbench scope, managed profile, and single-use identity; altered, expired, replayed, or cross-context assertions are denied.

classes.name: ManagedAccountProjection
classes.description: A bounded, read-only browser projection of the gateway-verified enterprise identity for one managed Code request, containing display name, fixed tenant, roles, scopes, and expiry without the assertion, credentials, or raw subject identifier.

classes.name: ManagedRepositoryCatalogue
classes.description: The operator-owned allowlist of canonical Git repositories and discovered worktrees available to one managed hosted Code instance; symlink, URL, arbitrary path, and filesystem-mount escapes are rejected.

classes.name: ManagedShikigamiProfile
classes.description: The fixed managed Shikigami 1.0.5+ Build profile using plane model routing, fail-closed sekai-chisei governance, and an environment allowlist that excludes ambient provider, platform, source-control, proxy, and host credentials.

classes.name: DelegatedConversationOutcomeProjection
classes.description: A beta-gated, read-only UI projection of the latest completed child turn. Its bounded summary is derived from child history and never enters parent provider context.

classes.name: ChildBoundHumanRequest
classes.description: A single-use approval or input request whose authority remains bound to the originating delegated child. A parent may project and resolve it only as a beta-gated human control surface.

classes.name: ChildInputCoordinationReceipt
classes.description: A durable receipt proving which child input request was answered, its route, and optional coordinating parent. It stores an answer digest rather than provider-visible parent context.

classes.name: LocalProjectChiseiBinding
classes.description: A loopback-administered local mapping from one Aldunis Code project to one Chisei namespace. It contains no endpoint credential or remote Action content.

classes.name: ChiseiActionProjection
classes.description: A bounded read-only projection of Chisei-owned Action, effect, and operation receipt identifiers and lifecycle state. It is never local domain authority.

classes.name: GovernedDirectRunCorrelation
classes.description: A metadata-only receipt linking a provider-confirmed Shikigami direct run to the equal Chisei operation identity. It does not imply Action admission or effect claim.

classes.name: CapabilityLinkedDeliverySession
classes.description: A durable Aldunis Code coordination ledger for one clean committed candidate. It advances only through previewed Chisei and Tenkai handoffs and never becomes governance or delivery authority.

classes.name: LocalDeliveryCandidate
classes.description: The content-bound aldunis.delivery-candidate/v1 identity over a canonical Git revision, source tree, Tenkai manifest, artifact tree, and declared build definition.

classes.name: ChiseiGovernedEvaluationReference
classes.description: A bounded local reference to a Chisei-owned governed-subject operation and receipt. The referenced authority is never copied into Aldunis Code.

classes.name: TenkaiDeliveryReference
classes.description: A bounded local reference to a Tenkai-owned release, channel, plan, environment, deployment, health, or rollback record.

classes.name: TenkaiTerminalOutcomeProjection
classes.description: A bounded Tenkai-owned read projection of a content-bound terminal deployment or rollback event. It exposes identities, evidence-binding digests, terminal state, observation time, delivery attempts, and delivery lag without payloads, retry errors, credentials, source, or logs.

classes.name: ChiseiObservationReadback
classes.description: A bounded authenticated Chisei readback addressed by a Tenkai terminal event identity and the local project's server-derived namespace. It exposes only request identity, namespace, safe projection digest, recorded state, and read times.

classes.name: ShikigamiRepairBrief
classes.description: A bounded Aldunis Code handoff that opens a normal Build conversation for investigating a failed or unknown Tenkai outcome. It carries stable evidence references and requires the ordinary Shikigami send and approval flow; it never starts a hidden provider run or reads foreign databases.

classes.name: DeliveryCorrelationReceipt
classes.description: An aldunis.delivery-receipt/v1 correlation export containing stable identities, digests, freshness, and completeness without signed assertions, credentials, source, command output, or approval material.

classes.name: AldunisDesktopAutoUpdater
classes.description: The packaged Electron main-process updater for Aldunis Code stable and nightly releases. It derives a fixed update feed from the packaged channel, enables prerelease checks only for nightly builds, exposes explicit check, download, and restart actions, publishes only bounded state through the preload bridge, rejects automatic downgrades, and establishes native installer ownership before the normal local host shutdown boundary runs.

classes.name: DesktopUpdateChannel
classes.description: The packaged desktop update stream selected by the application version: stable releases use the latest feed, while dated nightly releases use the nightly prerelease feed.

classes.name: DesktopShellEnvironment
classes.description: The Electron desktop startup boundary that imports a bounded PATH and selected non-secret session environment from the user's login shell before local provider discovery and subprocess launch; it never exposes those values to the renderer or changes provider credential ownership.

classes.name: DesktopWindowLifecycle
classes.description: The Electron desktop window lifecycle that keeps the local host and active provider sessions alive when a macOS window is closed, restores a live hidden window on activation or second launch, ignores activation races after the retained window is destroyed, and completes explicit application shutdown after bounded loopback-service cleanup without requiring a second Quit; Windows and Linux retain close-to-exit behavior.

classes.name: PersistedConversationRestoration
classes.description: A pure Aldunis Code projection module that deterministically reconstructs one provider-independent local conversation from persisted thread, turn, message, activity, plan, input, correlation, context, session, and checkpoint records. It preserves exact sequenced-record order, inserts unsequenced projection records deterministically, and carries no fetch, timer, notification, provider-process, or mutation authority.

classes.name: AutonomyRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates Autonomy route recognition, local and managed-host admission, request validation, managed projection filtering, persistence coordination, timestamps, and Autonomy engine invocation behind one internal dispatch interface without granting provider, filesystem, credential, tenant, or approval authority.

classes.name: ConversationAutomationRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates timer-only ConversationAutomation route recognition, local and managed-host admission, request validation, existing-conversation targeting, fire retry identity, persistence coordination, scheduler invocation, and response projection behind one internal dispatch interface without changing provider, filesystem, permission, credential, tenant, or approval authority.

classes.name: ChangedFileReviewRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates changed-file review route recognition, canonical worktree and conversation scope, current diff identity, file review and annotation validation, annotation projection, persistence ordering, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing repository or approval authority.

classes.name: ChangedFileReviewSessionModule
classes.description: A deep renderer module that concentrates current-versus-checkpoint review scope, changed-file selection repair, stale diff and annotation response suppression, local comment and revision-preview transitions, read-only resets, and nested dismissal priority behind one hook interface while ChangesPanel retains rendering and delivery state and the host retains repository and persistence authority.

classes.name: ConversationLifecycleRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates LocalConversation lifecycle route recognition, request validation, managed-host admission, explicit managed-worktree release guards, deletion ordering, delegated relationship admission, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing persistence, filesystem, provider, or approval authority.

classes.name: ProviderAdapterAdministrationRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates declarative provider adapter administration route recognition, remote and managed-host admission, response redaction, explicit approval, action routing, and default-profile seeding behind one internal dispatch interface without changing provider trust, credential, process, or approval authority.

classes.name: ConversationContextRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates ConversationContextPin route recognition, request validation, canonical worktree selection, remote and managed-host admission, repository search and browse cancellation, bounded image staging, context-package assembly, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing filesystem, repository, provider, or approval authority.

classes.name: CheckpointRewindRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates checkpoint preview, file-diff, and rewind route recognition, canonical worktree selection, checkpoint identity and Git state validation, active-turn exclusion, rewind ordering, checkpoint persistence, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing repository, filesystem, provider, or approval authority.

classes.name: ConversationWorkspaceRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates repository admission and registration, managed catalogue projection, local directory browsing authority, and managed worktree preview, approval, creation, and removal ordering behind one internal dispatch interface without changing repository, filesystem, persistence, provider, or approval authority.

classes.name: ChiseiProjectProjectionRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates Chisei project binding administration, request validation, server-owned namespace authority, bounded Action and observation projection reads, governance correlation ownership, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing Chisei domain authority, persistence, credentials, or transport ownership.

classes.name: DelegatedHumanControlRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates delegated approval and input-response route recognition, parent-child authority validation, single-use coordination, provider response routing, recovery, and thread-status publication behind one internal dispatch interface without changing provider, persistence, permission, or managed-host authority.

classes.name: DeliveryRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates source-control and capability-linked release delivery route recognition, request validation, host-mode admission, canonical worktree selection, pull-request projection, release-project correlation, cancellation lifetime, broker invocation, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing Code, Chisei, or Tenkai authority.

classes.name: CrossProviderConversationForkRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates reviewed cross-provider conversation fork route recognition, manifest validation, managed-host admission, canonical source and destination worktree selection, managed-worktree ownership and exclusivity, provider profile and model validation, provider readiness, and fork persistence behind one internal dispatch interface without changing provider, filesystem, persistence, or approval authority.

classes.name: WorkbenchProjectionRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates Workbench projection route recognition, coherent snapshot assembly, managed catalogue visibility, delegated outcome, approval, and input projection, bounded conversation history and search, managed-worktree inventory, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without changing persistence, filesystem, provider, permission, tenant, or product authority.

classes.name: LocalStateMaintenanceRouteDispatchModule
classes.description: A deep server-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates destructive local-state maintenance route recognition, request validation, managed-host admission, affected-project exclusion, checkpoint invalidation, Git reference cleanup, persistence ordering, lock release, and response mapping behind one internal dispatch interface without deleting conversation worktrees or changing filesystem, persistence, provider, permission, tenant, or product authority.

classes.name: ApplicationShellBootstrapModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates application-shell boot, project request coalescing and freshness, repository-open consequences, managed-aware restoration ordering, failure recovery, and lifecycle cancellation behind one interface while the local host retains repository and filesystem authority.

classes.name: ConnectionsSessionModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates Connections mode admission, loading, drafts, save-and-connect, re-pairing, disconnect and removal refresh, local restoration, host pairing and revocation, error recovery, and lifecycle cancellation behind one snapshot-and-intent interface while host and desktop adapters retain authority.

classes.name: AutonomyLedgerSessionModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates Autonomy ledger polling, load coalescing, forced post-mutation refresh, managed inspect-only admission, typed drafts and commands, error recovery, and lifecycle cancellation behind one snapshot-and-intent interface while the local host retains ledger, workflow, filesystem, provider, and approval authority.

classes.name: ConversationAutomationSessionModule
classes.description: A deep renderer-side Aldunis Code module that concentrates timer-only conversation automation loading, typed drafts, create, pause, enable, run, explicit unknown-fire retry, delete, post-command reload, error recovery, and lifecycle cancellation behind one snapshot-and-intent interface while the local host retains schedule, conversation, provider, permission, and persistence authority.

relations.name: coordinates_split_workspace_conversations
relations.description: The split workspace lifecycle module keeps primary and secondary LocalConversation selections distinct and safely projected without acquiring repository, persistence, provider, or filesystem authority.

relations.name: dispatches_through_local_api
relations.description: The local host delegates accepted HTTP requests and request-scoped authority facts to one internal dispatch module without creating a new network, product, or trust seam.

relations.name: delegates_remote_access_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates remote administration, device pairing, and descriptor requests through one internal interface while retaining shared authentication, origin checks, and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_autonomy_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates the Autonomy route family and request-scoped authority facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_conversation_automation_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates timer-only ConversationAutomation requests and request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_changed_file_review_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates changed-file review requests and scoped repository facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: uses_changed_file_review_session
relations.description: The conversation review surface delegates renderer-owned changed-file review lifetime to one session module without transferring delivery, repository, worktree, annotation persistence, or permission authority.

relations.name: delegates_conversation_lifecycle_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates LocalConversation lifecycle requests and request-scoped authority facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_provider_adapter_administration_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates declarative provider adapter administration requests and request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_provider_profile_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates provider discovery and ProviderProfile administration requests plus request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_provider_control_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates provider control requests and request-scoped managed-host facts through one internal interface while retaining shared authentication, origin checks, and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_conversation_context_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates ConversationContextPin requests and request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_checkpoint_rewind_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates checkpoint preview, diff, and rewind requests and scoped repository facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_conversation_workspace_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates Conversation workspace repository, directory, and worktree requests and request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_chisei_project_projection_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates Chisei project binding and bounded read requests plus request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_delegated_human_control_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates approval and input-response decisions plus request-scoped managed-host facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_delivery_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates source-control and capability-linked release delivery requests plus request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_cross_provider_conversation_fork_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates reviewed cross-provider conversation fork requests plus request-scoped host-mode facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_workbench_projection_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates Workbench load, conversation history, and bounded search requests plus request-scoped managed-host facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: delegates_local_state_maintenance_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates destructive project deletion and retention requests plus request-scoped managed-host facts through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: targets_existing_conversation
relations.description: Binds a timer-only automation to one existing local conversation; scheduling never creates a new conversation or worktree.

relations.name: records_automation_fire
relations.description: Records each scheduled slot or explicit manual request as one idempotent fire identity with bounded outcome and recovery state.

relations.name: uses_typed_flow
relations.description: Binds a durable autonomy execution to one typed workflow definition and its bounded step graph.

relations.name: records_autonomy_task
relations.description: Decomposes a durable autonomy execution into ordered, retryable, timeout-bounded task records.

relations.name: reports_maintenance_finding
relations.description: Records bounded maintenance findings as metadata for operator review rather than source or provider output.

relations.name: starts_autonomy_run
relations.description: Allows a heartbeat monitor, standing internal hook, or standing order context to initiate a durable autonomy run without changing its authority boundary.

relations.name: reacts_with_flow
relations.description: Maps one internal lifecycle hook to a built-in read-only typed flow subject to cooldown and local-host execution.

relations.name: informs_autonomy_run
relations.description: Provides bounded operator-authored preference context to an autonomy run without granting new authority.

relations.name: implements_read_only_flow
relations.description: Identifies the maintenance gardener as the shipped read-only implementation of a typed autonomy flow.

relations.name: projects_conversation_activity
relations.description: Projects bounded local conversation metadata into a cross-project activity inbox without copying conversation content or granting new execution authority.

relations.name: projects_work_graph
relations.description: Projects one recent conversation turn into the opt-in Work Graph beta view without persisting a new graph authority or changing provider and approval semantics.

relations.name: records_local_usage_receipt
relations.description: Records bounded provider-reported token and optional cost observations for local Code turns so the Usage view can aggregate them without importing native provider history or transferring usage authority to Chisei.

relations.name: renders_turn_change_summary
relations.description: Renders a completed turn's checkpoint-owned changed-file summary inline in the conversation and opens its immutable historical diff for review without changing the current worktree.

relations.name: uses_composer_popover_interaction
relations.description: The conversation composer delegates generic provider, model, mode, workspace, and project popover interaction lifetime to one renderer module without moving provider or workspace decisions behind that seam.

relations.name: uses_transcript_viewport_lifecycle
relations.description: The conversation composer delegates one pane's transcript viewport lifetime to a renderer module without transferring conversation, persistence, provider, filesystem, or permission authority.

relations.name: uses_workspace_panel_lifecycle
relations.description: The conversation composer delegates deterministic workspace-panel state transitions and explicit UI effect decisions to one renderer module without transferring DOM, repository, network, preview-process, or changed-file authority.

relations.name: exposes_host_commands
relations.description: The CLI exposes typed start and serve commands that route into the local host lifecycle without adding provider or terminal authority.

relations.name: exposes_remote_auth_commands
relations.description: The CLI exposes nested remote pairing commands for creating, listing, and revoking sessions before host startup.

relations.name: manages_remote_environments
relations.description: The Electron desktop manages saved remote-environment metadata and connection lifecycle without taking ownership of the remote repository or provider state.

relations.name: uses_ssh_remote_workbench_transport
relations.description: A desktop remote-environment manager may use the fixed SSH loopback transport for one saved environment.

relations.name: connects_remote_environment
relations.description: The SSH transport connects one saved remote environment through an explicit local port forward and proof-key pairing flow.

relations.name: gates
relations.description: Provider run readiness gates provider-dependent composer controls until eligibility is known or a bounded recovery action is presented.

relations.name: interprets_provider_discovery
relations.description: Provider run readiness interprets the host-owned discovery projection with selected profile and managed-mode constraints without becoming provider launch authority.

relations.name: uses_browser_speech_recognition
relations.description: The conversation composer may use the browser-owned speech-recognition capability to append transient transcript text without adding host, provider, persistence, or audio authority.

relations.name: uses_prompt_stash
relations.description: The conversation composer delegates complete text-only draft stash transactions to one local prompt-stash interface without gaining server persistence, transcript, provider, or execution authority.

relations.name: authenticates_managed_host
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench accepts API authority only from a verified gateway assertion.

relations.name: projects_managed_account
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench projects the current gateway-verified account into a bounded browser capability response without creating account or tenant authority in Code.

relations.name: previews_managed_worktree_removal
relations.description: The renderer worktree lifecycle obtains and approves only a host-issued single-use managed worktree removal plan without acquiring filesystem authority itself.

relations.name: constrains_managed_repository_access
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench resolves repository and worktree operations only through its operator-owned canonical catalogue.

relations.name: uses_managed_shikigami_profile
relations.description: The managed hosted workbench resolves every provider run to the fixed Shikigami Build profile.

relations.name: floats_constrained_preview
relations.description: Presents a running loopback-only preview in a transient fixed window without changing the preview's origin, sandbox, denied permissions, or approval boundary.

relations.name: coordinates_constrained_preview
relations.description: The renderer host-contract module serializes scoped preview intents and validates host snapshots without moving preview authority out of the local host.

relations.name: delegates_constrained_preview_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local API dispatch module delegates constrained-preview start, decision, status, and stop requests through one internal interface while retaining shared origin checks and error translation.

relations.name: coordinates_shared_browser_session
relations.description: The renderer host-contract module retains the validated conversation and origin binding needed for control, status, confirmed close, and best-effort cleanup.

relations.name: renders_ephemeral_browser_observation
relations.description: Shows at most the latest bounded provider browser frame in a transient floating view without granting page controls, provider credentials, navigation, or persistence authority.

relations.name: has_shared_browser_session
relations.description: Binds at most one desktop shared browser session to a local conversation without adding browser page state to conversation history.

relations.name: brokers_shared_browser_control
relations.description: Routes bounded provider browser operations through the host-owned broker and its explicit session control rule.

relations.name: mirrors_shared_browser
relations.description: Presents the same shared Electron page in a transient picture-in-picture window without creating a second browser session.

relations.name: enforces_provider_model_selection
relations.description: The model validation boundary protects each local conversation run and fork from stale, unknown, or unverifiable provider model selections.

relations.name: has_delegated_relationship
relations.description: Associates a parent conversation with a durable delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_delegated_child
relations.description: Identifies the one independently created child conversation projected by a delegated-conversation relationship.

relations.name: projects_quiet_outcome
relations.description: Exposes the latest bounded completed outcome for review without transferring conversation authority.

relations.name: projects_child_human_request
relations.description: Projects a pending child-bound human request without transferring its authority to the parent conversation.

relations.name: produces_input_coordination_receipt
relations.description: Records the single child-bound routing outcome of an answered input request.

relations.name: projects_chisei_actions
relations.description: Uses a server-owned local project binding to display bounded Chisei state without transferring namespace or mutation authority.

relations.name: records_governed_direct_run
relations.description: Associates a local Shikigami conversation with a bounded direct-run correlation receipt.

relations.name: uses_shikigami_checkpoint_resume_boundary
relations.description: The Code-side parked-run resume operation delegates checkpoint identity and native resume semantics to Shikigami after Code validates its local request and turn binding.

relations.name: preserves_local_conversation_turn
relations.description: Rebinds the resumed provider process to the existing local conversation turn rather than creating a synthetic answer message or child turn.

relations.name: binds_local_delivery_candidate
relations.description: Binds one capability-linked session to the exact immutable candidate it coordinates.

relations.name: references_chisei_evaluation
relations.description: Records a bounded Chisei evaluation reference without transferring governance authority.

relations.name: references_tenkai_delivery
relations.description: Records bounded reconciled Tenkai identifiers without transferring delivery or recovery authority.

relations.name: projects_tenkai_terminal_outcome
relations.description: Projects bounded Tenkai terminal deployment or rollback evidence into the local delivery ledger without transferring Tenkai authority.

relations.name: confirms_chisei_observation
relations.description: Confirms a Tenkai event identity against a bounded Chisei observation readback while preserving both products' authority boundaries.

relations.name: prepares_shikigami_repair
relations.description: Turns a failed or unknown terminal outcome into a bounded repair brief for a new normal Shikigami Build conversation.

relations.name: exports_delivery_correlation
relations.description: Exports one integrity-bounded correlation envelope from the current local session projection.

relations.name: persists_sidebar_open_preference
relations.description: Stores the shared Code sidebar's expanded or collapsed presentation state in the local browser or desktop profile without changing conversation or host state.

relations.name: uses_sidebar_lifecycle
relations.description: The collapsible Code sidebar delegates responsive, persistence, shortcut-admission, and focus transition decisions to one renderer lifecycle module without transferring DOM, conversation, repository, provider, or permission authority.

relations.name: exposes_sidebar_toggle_keybinding
relations.description: Exposes the fixed Mod+B presentation keybinding for collapsing or reopening the shared Code sidebar without granting authority over local work or provider actions.

relations.name: selects_desktop_update_channel
relations.description: The packaged updater selects exactly one stable or nightly feed from the installed desktop release identity without switching channels or granting downgrade authority.

relations.name: prepares_provider_discovery
relations.description: Desktop startup prepares the inherited process environment used by provider readiness probes and provider subprocesses without moving provider-specific credentials or authority into the desktop environment manager.

relations.name: restores_local_conversation
relations.description: Deterministically reconstructs the renderer-facing history and provider state for one identity-matched local conversation without changing persisted state or conversation authority.

relations.name: coordinates_conversation_run
relations.description: Concentrates renderer-side normalized run transitions for one local conversation while provider adapters, persistence, worktree ownership, and permission authority remain outside the module.

relations.name: delegates_provider_run_execution
relations.description: The local host dispatch module passes parsed run input, request-scoped authority facts, and an HTTP output adapter to the typed provider-run admission interface without creating a new network or trust seam.

relations.name: fires_through_provider_run_admission
relations.description: A conversation automation invokes the typed provider-run admission interface directly and derives its durable fire outcome from local run state without a loopback HTTP self-request.

relations.name: follows_up_through_provider_run_admission
relations.description: Delegated human control invokes the typed provider-run admission interface directly and releases its control lock when the child run is accepted without bypassing normal run admission.

relations.name: delegates_browser_route_dispatch
relations.description: The local host dispatch module delegates recognized shared-browser requests and request-scoped authority facts to one internal browser route module without moving browser ownership or creating a new trust seam.

relations.name: executes_local_conversation_run
relations.description: Concentrates the server-side lifecycle for one local conversation run while provider process variation remains behind existing adapters and permission authority remains with the PermissionBroker.

relations.name: stages_composer_images
relations.description: Concentrates the bounded composer image staging transaction while the conversation composer retains drag, paste, presentation, and pin-state ownership and the host retains filesystem authority.

relations.name: synchronizes_application_shell_with_host
relations.description: The renderer application shell uses host projections and repository-open contracts through one bootstrap lifecycle without acquiring host authority.

relations.name: coordinates_desktop_remote_environments
relations.description: The renderer Connections session coordinates explicit intents through the desktop manager without owning remote-environment metadata, SSH transport, credentials, repositories, providers, or conversations.

relations.name: projects_autonomy_runs
relations.description: The renderer Autonomy ledger session projects durable run state and submits bounded typed intents without acquiring execution or mutation authority.

relations.name: projects_conversation_automations
relations.description: The renderer automation session projects timer-only conversation automations and submits bounded typed intents without acquiring schedule, run, permission, provider, or persistence authority.
